description: This source file defines a Java class 'BusinessStepExceptionMapper' that implements an ExceptionMapper for handling BusinessStepException exceptions within a JAX-RS (Java API for RESTful Web Services) application. It maps exceptions to HTTP responses with detailed error information.

classes.name: BusinessStepExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS ExceptionMapper that converts BusinessStepException into an HTTP 400 Bad Request response containing error details.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a BusinessStepException into a HTTP Response object with error details and status code 400.
